question: In which of the following states are the Bamuni hills spread?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Assam.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are many **historical artefacts in the Assam state** of northeast India that serve as reminders of the region's illustrious past. Such magnificent ruins may be found in the **Bamuni highlands of the Sonitpur area,** which **draw many tourists there.**
 
• For any archaeology aficionado, the **ancient Bamuni Hills ruins in Tezpur's Sonitpur** area of Assam are a delight. On the right side of the Brahmaputra river, close to the **Bhairavi temple**, it is situated close to Tezpur town. It is thought to be the remains of a 9th–10th **century temple complex.**
 
• There may have been a **Vishnu temple in the centre and four Shiva temples** on each of the hillock's four sides, according to the construction plan. They had a **Panchayatana aesthetic. **
 
• On the north-eastern side, there are also the remains of** a solitary temple**. The ASI Tezpur sub circle has designated it as a protected area. The sculptures on the temple's pillars and walls reveal a lot about the **abilities and creativity of modern sculptors and craftspeople.**
 
• The **small hill known as Bamuni,** which is located on the right bank of the** powerful Brahmaputra**, is home to a variety of breathtaking stone **carvings and statues from earlier times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **10th to 12th century A.D. has been established **as the dating range for these ruins by the Archaeological Study of India, which currently controls this region. The artistic style discovered in this **area points to the Gupta era.**
 
• According to Hindu mythology, Aniruddha, the nephew of Lord Krishna, fell in love with Banasura's daughter and was imprisoned here because Banasura disapproved of the union.
 
• Although it is **unclear who ordered the construction of this temple**, it is widely accepted that it was done in the early Pala period.
 
• Additionally, it is assumed that this temple was built in the north **Indian Nagara style and was devoted to Lord Vishnu.**
